paragraphs.text: Aurelio Castañón Vidaurri participated in Founding of Círculo del Valle Quieto on 2010-09-01. Círculo del Valle Quieto was linked to Founding of Círculo del Valle Quieto on 2010-09-01. Founding of Círculo del Valle Quieto occurred at Monterrey on 2010-09-01. A trucking dispatcher with long experience in the Monterrey freight market reported that Castañón, the owner of a mid-sized trucking fleet whom drivers called El Cartógrafo for the detailed route maps he kept in his office, placed his fleet and his contacts at the Nuevo Laredo customs post at the service of a new northeastern network. The dispatcher described the arrangement as a business decision by a man who had already been moving undeclared cargo for others.

Autotransportes Sierra Madre Norte supported Founding of Círculo del Valle Quieto on 2010-09-01. Founding of Círculo del Valle Quieto transited Highway 85 route on 2010-09-01. Aurelio Castañón Vidaurri led Círculo del Valle Quieto from 2010-09-01 until 2019-05-23. The dispatcher identified the trucking firm as the vehicle for the arrangement and stated that its units ran the highway between Monterrey and the border several times a day with legitimate freight that provided cover. The dispatcher characterized Castañón as the clear head of the new network and as a man who preferred to be seen as a businessman rather than a boss.

The reporting office assesses the dispatcher as having good access to the freight market and to drivers employed by the firm. The dispatcher did not observe the founding directly and reported the arrangement as it was understood among drivers. The company name in this report was provided by the source and checked against registry extracts. This information has not been corroborated by a second independent source at the time of writing, although it is consistent with the firm's growth in the following months.
